rules.sentence: Any prolonged repetitive movements increase the risk of tendon irritation and, thus, tenosynovitis.
Tenosynovitis can be idiopathic; these patients have no established cause for their condition.
Infective tenosynovitis is caused by infective pathogens proliferating within the tendon sheaths.
They reach the sheaths either by direct inoculation from injury or can spread from local or distant infections.
